name: Curio — Antique Identifier: Curator
description: Curio identifies antiques, vintage items and collectibles from a photo and provides estimated value, history, rarity and authenticity guidance.

name: Card value scanner - MonValue
description: Photograph a trading card to identify it, check current market estimates, follow price movement and keep your collection organised in one portfolio.

name: Bluetooth Speaker Mic: BlueMic
description: Connect to a Bluetooth speaker or headphones, speak through your iPhone in real time and shape the sound with voice filters, echo control and custom mic styles.

name: Coin Identifier: CoinScope
description: Photograph a coin to identify its country, year, denomination and composition, explore estimated value and rarity, and keep your finds in a digital collection.

name: Storage Cleaner: CleanKit
description: Find duplicate photos, review large videos, swipe through clutter and clean up contacts and calendar events with a clear, review-first workflow.

name: Video Compressor: VideoShrink
description: Compress videos by up to 80%, tune resolution, frame rate and bitrate, and see the expected storage savings before you save or share the result.

name: Any Pantry
description: Keep pantry items, quantities and storage locations together with shopping lists and recipes.

name: Bird Book
description: Build a birding collection, set spotting goals and explore species information.
features: Explore species data, calls and behavior
steps: Record where and when you spotted the bird, its size, colors and behavior.
Compare species information and calls, checking several distinguishing features.
Save the sighting to your collection and review your spotting goals.

name: Skedge
description: Organize schedules, assignments, subtasks and reminders in one planner.
features: Manage personal, school and work schedules
steps: Add your fixed classes, work hours and appointments to a schedule.
Break assignments into subtasks and give each a deadline before the final due date.
Set reminders and review unfinished tasks regularly to adjust your plan.

name: Daily Devotion
description: Build a daily scripture, prayer and reflection routine with verses, guided prayer and reminders.
features: Read daily scripture and browse the Bible
Use guided prayer and revisit prayer history
Save verses and set devotional reminders
steps: Choose a consistent time and read a short scripture passage in context.
Use a prayer prompt to reflect on the passage and record your prayer.
Save a meaningful verse and set a reminder for your next devotional time.

name: PDF Scanner
description: Scan documents into PDFs, organize pages, merge files and share documents.
steps: Place the document on a flat surface with even lighting and capture every page.
Review the scan for readable text, correct page order and missing edges before saving.
Merge or split pages as needed, then share the PDF and check that the recipient can open it.

name: PDF Photos
description: Convert photos to PDF documents with custom layouts and paper sizes.
features: Convert multiple photos into a PDF
Choose layouts and US, A4 or A3 paper sizes
steps: Select the photos you want to include and put them in reading order.
Choose a paper size and layout, then check that each photo fits without cutting off important details.
Export the PDF, open it to inspect every page, and share the checked file.

name: BeeFlow
description: Track work hours by client and project, review weekly activity and export reports.
features: Log hours or use a clock-in timer
Organize time by client and project
Review activity history and export reports
steps: Create a client and project so each time entry has a clear purpose.
Start the timer when work begins or log hours with notes after each session.
Review the weekly breakdown, correct missed entries and export a report for your records.

name: Gratitude Journal
description: Write three gratitude entries a day with prompts, mood tracking and reminders.
features: Use prompts and record your mood
steps: Pick a regular moment and write three specific things you appreciated today.
Use a prompt if you feel stuck, and add a mood tag to give the entry context.
Return to past entries and use reminders to maintain a routine that works for you.

name: Invoice Maker and Receipt
description: Manage businesses and clients, create invoices and send them to customers.
steps: Choose the business issuing the invoice and check the client contact details.
Create the invoice and review its amounts and description against the work agreed with the client.
Check the finished invoice before sending it, and keep a copy for your records.
